title: Which CCA the Wearable-102 transfer reports
question: Why does matched CCA in the BETA to Wearable-102 transfer export read 65.38% dry and 81.65% wet, while the dry-vs-wet page shows CCA at 65.47% and 81.56% on the same windows?
answer: The two CCAs differ in one setting: the harmonic count of the sine/cosine references. The transfer study recomputed CCA with the BETA CCA-adapter definition (harmonics 1 to 3, six reference columns), which is also the fixed CCA term inside the 105 models. The dry-vs-wet benchmark uses harmonics 1 to 4 (eight reference columns). Both read the same prepared array of 24,480 windows (sha256 b8e039b1...), both centre data and references over time, both use a relative rank threshold of 1e-10 on the signal basis and take the largest canonical correlation, and both break exact ties at the first candidate. With the harmonic count set to three, the dry-vs-wet code reproduces the transfer code to 6.7e-16 on synthetic windows. Adding the fourth harmonic gives a net 12 more correct dry windows (8,014 against 8,002 of 12,240) and a net 11 fewer correct wet windows (9,983 against 9,994).

transfer_matched_cca.protocol_text: CCA-RAW recomputed on exactly the same mapped target windows, three sine/cosine harmonics, centered time coordinates, SVDrelative rank threshold1e-10
transfer_matched_cca.handoff_text: Both target CCA controls were freshly calculated with the source experiment's three-harmonic definition on these exact same windows; old target CCA score files were not reused.
transfer_matched_cca.reference_construction: sin and cos of 2*pi*h*f*t for h = 1, 2, 3, with t = n/250 s for n = 0..499 from the first sample of the window; each reference row centred over time; orthonormal basis from an SVD with relative rank threshold 1e-10 (adapter_core.refs, transform raw, _basis)
transfer_matched_cca.signal_side: float64; each channel centred over time; orthonormal basis from an SVD with relative rank threshold 1e-10; score = largest singular value of the cross-product of the two bases (adapter_core.canonical_correlations, cca_scores with domain raw)
transfer_matched_cca.channels: native eight channels reordered to PO5, PO3, POZ, PO4, PO6, O1, OZ, O2 (protocol input.channel_order 3,1,0,2,4,6,5,7); no rescaling or refiltering
transfer_matched_cca.score_storage: float64 (transfer_runner SCHEMAS rho_raw); argmax over float64; float64 against float32 argmax mismatches 0 of 24,480
transfer_matched_cca.ties: np.argmax, first index in the documented target-axis order
transfer_matched_cca.same_as_model_term: The models score 20 x (rho - 0.5) + bias + 2 x tanh(correction), and rho is this same raw three-harmonic CCA (transfer_runner passes rho_raw to the model; adapter_core forward), so matched CCA is the CCA built into the models.
transfer_matched_cca.metric: per person accuracy over 120 windows per sensor, mean over 102 people; one deterministic prediction per window

dry_vs_wet_cca.protocol_text: Largest canonical correlation with centered sine/cosine references at each documented target frequency.
dry_vs_wet_cca.reference_construction: sin and cos of 2*pi*h*f*t for h = 1..4, with t = n/250 s for n = 0..499 from the first sample of the window; each reference column centred over time; orthonormal basis from numpy QR (run_benchmark.reference_bases, default harmonics=4)
dry_vs_wet_cca.signal_side: float64; each channel centred over time; orthonormal basis from an SVD with relative rank threshold 1e-10; score = largest singular value of the cross-product (run_benchmark.cca_scores_batch)
dry_vs_wet_cca.channels: native eight channels in the stored order POz, PO3, PO4, PO5, PO6, Oz, O1, O2
dry_vs_wet_cca.score_storage: scores written as float32 (cca-scores.npy, sha256 4ec81c8d...); argmax over the float32 scores
dry_vs_wet_cca.ties: numpy argmax, first index in the documented target-axis order
dry_vs_wet_cca.metric: participant_mean_balanced_accuracy: balanced accuracy per participant over 120 windows per sensor, mean over 102 participants
dry_vs_wet_cca.page: site/src/pages/[...lang]/topics/dry-vs-wet.astro renders these rows in the analytic references table and does not name the harmonic count

harmonics.dry_vs_wet_cca: fundamental, second, third and fourth harmonic (h = 1..4)

highest_reference_frequency_hz.note: range of h x f over the 12 targets for the top harmonic; both inside the 6 to 80 Hz prepared band and below the 125 Hz Nyquist limit

harmonics.effect: This is the one definitional difference. The four-harmonic reference space contains the three-harmonic one, so every candidate score is equal or higher with four harmonics; a decision changes only when the fourth harmonic lifts another candidate past the one the three-harmonic CCA chose.

reference_construction.difference: QR basis of centred references (dry-vs-wet) against SVD basis with a 1e-10 relative rank threshold (transfer)
reference_construction.effect: None beyond floating point: both span the same centred sine/cosine space, which has full rank here, and canonical correlations depend only on the two spaces. Synthetic check: 6.7e-16 maximum score difference at three harmonics.
reference_construction.shared: sine and cosine pairs, so the phase origin of t (window start, 0.14 s after onset) does not affect either score

windows.shared: the same prepared array epochs250.npy, sha256 b8e039b1bf2fe3222f0627148fe2b1581a3bbd0f8fda9d8fe6c35f2ce873b19b, shape 24,480 x 8 x 500, float32: samples 160 to 660 at 250 Hz, i.e. 0.14 to 2.14 s after stimulus onset; fourth-order Butterworth 6 to 80 Hz, zero phase (sosfiltfilt), applied to each 500-sample epoch; stored amplitudes; 102 people x 2 sensors x 10 blocks x 12 targets; 12,240 windows per sensor
evidence: research/decision_route3_external_20261015/freeze.json and state/intake-manifest.json bind the transfer input epochs250.npy to b8e039b1... and its protocol.json to ccc489c2..., which is the sha256 of experiments/deployment_v2/wearable/protocol.json (the dry-vs-wet protocol).
experiments/deployment_v2/wearable/eegnet-transfer-protocol.json gives prepared_input_sha256 b8e039b1... for the dry-vs-wet benchmark input.
experiments/deployment_v2/wearable_trca/protocol.json binds signal_sha256 b8e039b1... together with the dry-vs-wet cca-scores.npy 4ec81c8d...

channels.difference: channel order only (transfer reorders to the BETA model order)
channels.effect: none: canonical correlations do not depend on channel order; synthetic check 5.0e-16

metric.difference: participant-mean balanced accuracy (dry-vs-wet) against participant-mean accuracy (transfer)
metric.effect: none: every person has 10 windows of each of the 12 targets per sensor, so balanced accuracy equals accuracy, and with 120 windows per person the participant mean equals correct windows / 12,240

intervals.dry_vs_wet_cca: participant bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20260920, percentile (deployment protocol metrics.uncertainty; run_benchmark.py participant_metrics)
intervals.transfer_matched_cca: paired person bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 20261015, percentile; conditional on the fixed 105 models for model rows (export bootstrap block)
intervals.effect: the point values are unaffected; the intervals differ slightly because the draws and seeds differ

score_precision.difference: argmax over float32-stored scores (dry-vs-wet) against float64 (transfer)
score_precision.effect: The transfer study found 0 float64 against float32 argmax changes for its three-harmonic CCA over all 24,480 windows. The same check was not run on the four-harmonic scores; it could only matter on near-ties.

card7.sentence_en: Matched CCA here uses sine and cosine references up to the third harmonic, as the models' own CCA term does, and reached 65.38% dry and 81.65% wet; the dry-versus-wet page's CCA uses references up to the fourth harmonic on the same windows and reached 65.47% and 81.56%.
card7.sentence_zh: 此处的匹配 CCA 与模型内部的 CCA 项相同，使用到三次谐波的正弦和余弦参考信号，干电极为 65.38%、湿电极为 81.65%；「干电极与湿电极」页面的 CCA 在相同窗口上使用到四次谐波的参考信号，为 65.47% 和 81.56%。

a2_fact_for_plan_template.en: the dry-versus-wet page's CCA uses references up to the fourth harmonic

synthetic_check.what: A scratch script (not kept in the repo) took the CCA functions from both source files by AST, without running either module, and scored 240 synthetic eight-channel windows (seed 20261020) at the 12 Wearable-102 frequencies. No recording was read.

verification.not_done: The real windows and the stored four-harmonic score file live in private run directories that are not on this machine, and this package allows no network, so the 12 and 11 window differences were not re-derived by scoring the real windows with both definitions. They follow from the published levels and the code above.
